clinicalNotes: High-dose metronidazole regimens (single oral dose of 2 g) are not recommended during pregnancy.
Off-label for women aged younger than 18 years.
Second and third trimester only for clindamycin.
Clindamycin cream damages latex condoms and diaphragms – counselling required.
